what.text: This page follows refugees from Ghana living in Italy, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 706 Ghanaian refugees in Italy, 4.4% of all refugees from Ghana.
Togo hosts the most Ghanaian refugees, followed by Canada, the United States and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ghana with military factions in 1981 and 1983.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2016 to 2019, come long after those conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1983 at 18 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 5953, at the end of 2019, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
These are year-end totals for Italy only, reported to UNHCR.
